experimental_method: Fixed-volume gold-lined pressure vessels loaded with weighed methane and degassed NaCl brine, heated stepwise; the intersection of the two-phase and single-phase liquid P-T curves gives the saturation T, P for the known methane molality.
uncertainties_stated: Not stated for T, P or molality; Setschenow constant 0.129 +- 0.030 (pressure of the intersection point is the main uncertainty source).
quality_remarks: Preliminary USGS report not reviewed for editorial standards. Pressure at the intersection is hard to resolve (line BC is steep). Temperature scale not stated. Pure-water runs (1-7) and brine runs are at 190-292 C only. Other tabular results (smoothed solubility) appear only as figures.
not_extracted_tables: Figures 3-9 smoothed solubility isobars and eq. 4-5 coefficients: fitted/derived, no tables
